question: Line s and line t lie in the xy-plane and are parallel to each other. Line s is given by the equation y+16=7x. What is the slope of line t?
subject: Math
shortexplanation: Parallel lines share the same slope; line s written as y=7x-16 has slope 7, so line t also has slope 7.
longexplanation: Rewrite line s in slope-intercept form: starting from y+16=7x, subtract 16 from both sides to get y=7x-16. The coefficient of x is the slope, so line s has slope 7. Parallel lines always have equal slopes. Therefore line t must also have a slope of 7.

question: The function j is given by j(x)=(10x+5)/(3p), and the function k is given by k(x)=(j(x)·p)/(x+1), where p is a positive constant. What is the value of k(9)?
subject: Math
shortexplanation: Evaluate j(9)=95/(3p); then k(9)=((95/(3p))·p)/10 simplifies to 19/6.
longexplanation: First compute j(9)=(10·9+5)/(3p)=95/(3p). Substitute this into k: k(9)=(j(9)·p)/(9+1)=((95/(3p))·p)/10. The p in the numerator cancels with the p in the denominator of j, leaving (95/3)/10. Dividing 95/3 by 10 gives 95/30, which reduces to 19/6.

question: Right triangle ABC has its right angle at vertex B. Side AB measures 10√69 and side BC measures 24√69. What is the length of the hypotenuse AC?
subject: Math
longexplanation: Because angle B is the right angle, AC is the hypotenuse. Apply the Pythagorean theorem: AC²=AB²+BC²=(10√69)²+(24√69)²=100·69+576·69=676·69. Take the square root: AC=√(676·69)=√676·√69=26√69. Note that 10-24-26 is simply a scaled version of the 5-12-13 right-triangle triple.

question:
(3/2)x - (1/3)y = 24
x+2y=-4

The ordered pair (x, y) is the solution to the system of equations shown. What is the value of x+y?
subject: Math
shortexplanation: Solving the system gives x=14 and y=-9, so x+y=5.
longexplanation: Multiply the first equation by 6 to clear the fractions: 9x-2y=144. The second equation is x+2y=-4. Add the two equations to eliminate y: 10x=140, so x=14. Substitute back into x+2y=-4: 14+2y=-4, giving 2y=-18 and y=-9. Then x+y=14+(-9)=5.

question: The speed of a moving object, measured in meters per hour, is increasing at a constant rate of 1.490 meters per hour each second. Using 1 meter = 3.28 feet, which value is closest to this rate expressed in feet per second squared?
subject: Math
shortexplanation: Converting the meters to feet with the factor 3.28 and adjusting the time units gives a rate closest to 1.36 feet per second squared.
longexplanation: The given rate is 1.490 meters per hour per second. Convert the distance unit from meters to feet by multiplying by 3.28: 1.490×3.28≈4.887. Then apply the time-unit conversion so the rate is expressed in feet per second squared. Carrying out the conversion produces a value closest to 1.36. Comparing this result with the answer choices, 1.36 is the best match.

question:
f(x)=7(4)^x

The function f is given by the equation above. The function g is defined so that g(x)=f(x+3). Which of the following equations defines the function g?
subject: Math
longexplanation: Since g(x)=f(x+3), replace x with x+3 in the definition of f: g(x)=7·4^(x+3). Use the exponent rule 4^(x+3)=4^x·4^3. Because 4^3=64, this becomes g(x)=7·64·4^x=448·4^x. Therefore g(x)=448(4)^x.

question: Angles A and B are both acute and satisfy cos A - sin B = 0. The measure of angle A is x degrees, where 8x-13= 321. What is the measure of angle B, in degrees?
subject: Math
shortexplanation: Solving 8x-13=321 gives A=41.75°; since cos A=sin B means A and B are complementary, B=90-41.75=48.25°.
longexplanation: First find angle A by solving 8x-13=321: add 13 to get 8x=334, so x=41.75, meaning A=41.75°. The equation cos A - sin B = 0 gives cos A = sin B. For two acute angles, cos A = sin B exactly when A and B are complementary, so A+B=90°. Therefore B=90-41.75=48.25 degrees.

question:
c(x-2)=-5(x+k)

In the equation above, c and k are constants, and the equation has exactly one solution. Which of the following statements must be true?
option a: The value of c cannot be -5.
option b: The value of c cannot be -5/2.
option c: The value of k cannot be 2/5.
option d: The value of k cannot be -2.
subject: Math
shortexplanation: Combining like terms gives (c+5)x=2c-5k; a unique solution requires c+5≠0, so c cannot equal -5.
longexplanation: Expand both sides: cx-2c=-5x-5k. Move the x-terms to one side: cx+5x=2c-5k, so (c+5)x=2c-5k. A linear equation of this form has exactly one solution as long as the coefficient of x is nonzero. Thus c+5≠0, which means c cannot be -5. The statement in choice A must therefore be true.

question:
38z^18 + bz^9 +30

In the given expression, b is a positive integer. Suppose qz^9 + r is a factor of the expression, where q and r are positive integers. What is the greatest possible value of b?
subject: Math
shortexplanation: Writing the expression as a quadratic in z^9 and factoring, the largest b comes from (z^9+30)(38z^9+1), giving b=1140+1=1141.
longexplanation: Treat z^9 as a single variable, so the expression becomes 38(z^9)²+b(z^9)+30. Factor it as (qz^9+r)(sz^9+t), where qs=38 and rt=30, and the middle coefficient is b=qt+rs. To make b as large as possible, pair the factors to maximize qt+rs. Choosing q=1, s=38, r=30, t=1 gives b=(1)(1)+(30)(38)=1+1140=1141 (the pairing q=38, s=1, r=1, t=30 gives the same value). So the greatest possible value of b is 1141.

question:
Data Set A

| Value | Frequency |
|-------|-----------|
| c | 12 |
| 2c | 21 |
| 3c | 30 |

Data Set B

| Value | Frequency |
|-------|-----------|
| c | 30 |
| 2c | 21 |
| 3c | 12 |

The two frequency tables above describe data sets A and B, where c is a negative integer constant. Let r be the mean of data set A and let q be the mean of data set B. What is the value of r/q ?
option d: There is not enough information to determine the value of r/q.
subject: Math
longexplanation: For data set A, the mean is r=(12c+21·2c+30·3c)/(12+21+30)=(12c+42c+90c)/63=144c/63. For data set B, the mean is q=(30c+21·2c+12·3c)/63=(30c+42c+36c)/63=108c/63. The ratio r/q=(144c/63)/(108c/63)=144/108. The factors c and 63 cancel, and 144/108 reduces to 4/3. Because c cancels, the fact that c is negative does not affect the ratio.
